desc.zh: left、right 围住尚未结算区域。left_max 包含从起点到 left 的最高墙，right_max 包含从 right 到末尾的最高墙；先把当前两端柱子纳入最大值，再比较。
desc.en: left and right bound the unsettled region. left_max is the highest wall through left, and right_max the highest from right to the end. Include the current endpoint bars before comparing these maxima.

concepts.name: Settled water and running maxima
concepts.description: Prove why the lower known maximum settles one endpoint.
